<b>Clawmaidens</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are basic automatons of [[the Citadel]] veiled in a pointed white cloth capable of stealing [[Silk]] from nearby sources.<ref>Clawmaiden [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Puppet servant of the Citadel, suspended on strings of Silk. An early form of automaton, requiring extensive Silk to maintain its service."</i></ref><ref>Clawmaiden Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"If given a chance, this one will steal Silk from any significant source, including my own shell."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
Clawmaidens have a 25% chance to be called during encounters with [[Envoy|Envoys]], [[Grand Reed|Grand Reeds]], [[Maestro|Maestros]], and [[Reed|Reeds]] in certain rooms. Their spawning can be permanently disabled by cutting the threads of the Clawmaiden core, which controls them. It is located in a secret room in the [[High Halls]]. They will also be disabled by beginning Act 3 (after which the secret room will be inaccessible). Before Act 3, the room is accessible by pushing carts with blows from the Needle and using them as platforms to reach a hole in the ceiling with the [[Faydown Cloak]].

Disabling the Clawmaidens, either by cutting the threads or beginning Act 3, also completes their entry in the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] if it has not been completed already. Disabling them also destroys any currently alive Clawmaidens, dropping [[Shell Shards]] as usual.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Being flying Enemies, Clawmaidens attempt to keep diagonal aerial distance from Hornet, flying mainly horizontally away from her, but always trying to be vertically above her as well.
Clawmaidens have 3 different moves they can perform:
* <b>Claw Slash:</b> Screeches and slashes at Hornet twice. Only used if she's very close to it.
* <b>Silk Siphon & Silken Arrow:</b> Begins to siphon Silk from Hornet if she has at least 3 strands of silk, floating away from her all the while. Once it has taken a total of 3 strands of silk, it creates a giant arrow of silk which, after aiming, flies at Hornet and homes in very slightly, bursting on impact with a surface and dealing {{Damage|2}} if it hits.
* <b>Reposition:</b> Flies upwards offscreen and drops back down somewhere near Hornet. Mainly used if she attempts to flee out of range. This move is also how they are summoned into rooms.

== Location ==
Clawmaidens can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]] and [[High Halls]], and during the [[the Forum]] gauntlet, randomly descending from the ceilings. Once the thread in their control room is cut, or by entering [[Act 3]], they will stop appearing completely.

== Trivia ==
* Clawmaidens used to be able to drop organs for the <i>[[Broodfeast]]</i> [[Wishes|Wish]]. This was patched in an [[Updates (Silksong)|update]].{{MissingInfo}}.
* The [[Needolin]] can be used on the Clawmaiden core in the High Halls causing it to vibrate and producing the same Needolin dialogue as the Clawmaidens themselves.
* After disabling the Clawmaidens by cutting the threads, the icon for a completed [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|journal entry]] appears, even if the entry has already been completed.
* As seen in their concept sketches, their name is a play on [[wikipedia:Handmaiden|handmaiden]].
**The 1.0.27535 version of <i>Silksong</i> playable on PlayStation 4, which is older than the PC launch version (1.0.28324), has the Clawmaiden be named Handmaiden.<ref>[https://www.diffchecker.com/Nu85hOJA/ Comparison of 1.0.27535 (PlayStation 4) and 1.0.27776 (Early Nintendo Switch build)]</ref>
